content: Audio: ogg recommended (re-encode via ffmpeg 44.1kHz stereo vorbis), wav max 44.1kHz, args.audio hash with gain/pitch/looping/playtime; dragonruby-publish warns on bad encoding (7.6); no mp3 guidance. Pixel art: metadata scale_quality=3 = pixel art scaling (7.0), sprite/label scale_quality_enum 3; HD mode all tiers, highdpi Pro; Layout API for safe-area grid. Source: docs, changelog.
